firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'Custom tattoos, drawn for you in Brooklyn.' gives trade, place and outcome, with the italic violet transfer on 'drawn for you'. The phone is shown as text in the header and in the proof line, and the hero plate is now a real healed luna-moth forearm with a stencil inset ('next one, 1/4 in. lower'), so the round-1 fixes landed. 390-first.jpg: h1 4 lines, both actions above the fold, the ghost plate is gone. Holding it at 9: at 390 the photo strip is a 120px letterbox that crops the moth to a sliver, and at 1440 the grey stencil inset muddies the lower third of the photo.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the sheet stack and register marks now carry hero, Styles (S1-S8 tabs plus a struck-through 'S9 · NO Lines under 2 cm' sheet), process, rules, estimator ('SHEET FOR YOU'), deposit, review slips with a tally, timeline, form and footer. Nothing like sibling B. Still 'h2 left, grey side note right' as the intro for Styles, Process, Estimator and Reviews (1440-full.jpg).

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Instrument Serif + Hanken, tight display, italic transfer word used with a job in each h2, and a real scale moment in the violet 'Bring the screenshot.' band. 'BOOK THIS' caps became sentence-case 'Ask about this'. Hours use en dashes in dist. Remaining: tiny tracked caps stack in the rail labels plus sheet tabs (1440-scroll-75.jpg 'SLIPS · REVIEWS', 'SAMPLE REVIEW', 'SLIP · TALLY' in one view).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: timeline and deposit are now separate jobs, the reviews column closes with the 4.9 tally (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Deductions: the Styles S1 'Custom tattoos' sheet is 570px tall for 3 lines and leaves ~300px of blank paper (1440-full.jpg Styles, -0.5); the form 'Next sheet' button sits outside the sheet and the form column stops at ~1195px, leaving the right 180px and everything under the button empty (1440-full.jpg contact). The process story still spends ~2.5 screens on five sheets (1440-scroll-25.jpg).

photo.notes: 1440-first.jpg: the healed moth is now the hero plate, which is the right proof. But the page has only two photos, and the second (1440-scroll-50.jpg, 'Healed is the only photo that counts') spends half its frame on a cornfield, and its neo-traditional portrait sleeve is not the fine-line or botanical work the page sells (-0.5). The two frames do not share a grade: the hero is warm skin on grey-brown, the break is green and cool plaid (-0.5). Reviews and services, where healed proof would carry weight, have no photo.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the 'one we say no to' promise is now kept with the S9 'Lines under 2 cm' sheet and its reason. 'Book my six-week check' now sits under Day 42, where it belongs (1440-full.jpg timeline). Hours are printed once, and the footer says 'See the full week'. Every rating, review, price and term carries a Sample label (1440-full.jpg estimator, deposit, footer licence). Voice is specific ('Itchy is normal; picking isn't.'). Small: the rules band ('Clean you can watch.') and the photo break both lean on the same 'in front of you' idea already used in the hero.

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: services now compose 2-up (no 2,400px single column), the timeline has a left rail with the labels padded off it, and the process becomes thumb plus text sheets. No overflow at 320/390 (render.json). The sticky bar has Book plus Text (390-full.jpg after the hero). Not a 10: the 390-first.jpg photo strip is too short to read as healed work, and the form and contact still stack desktop order.

a11y.notes: render.json has no errors and no console errors. 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every word, and the process collapses to five readable sheets with every drawing state. Headings run in order, inputs have visible labels, and the timeline labels are no longer struck through (1440-full.jpg timeline). Focus rings cannot be verified from stills.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the sticky plate redraws the sprig sheet by sheet, so the motion explains the process; the transfer line draws under the h1 and the estimator stencil scales with the size slider (1440-full.jpg estimator). Unchanged from round 1: the Styles, reviews, rules and deposit bands still appear to share one reveal stagger, and the hero photo and its stencil inset do not move as a transfer (1440-first.jpg).

wow.notes: 1440-first.jpg: the healed photo with a violet stencil overlay is now a thesis image, and the process redraw (1440-scroll-25.jpg) plus the estimator stencil on a limb (1440-full.jpg) are trade-specific. Still short of a shortlist moment: the estimator result sheet is small and sits beside the inputs, and the process ends at sheet 05 with a drawing, not the skin.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the timeline strike-through is fixed and the footer is a designed close with SAMPLE LICENCE. Defects: in the form, the 'Tell us the idea' label touches the bottom of the radio grid with ~0px gap (1440-full.jpg contact, -0.5); drop shadows still sit on every resting sheet.

elevate.move: Make healed skin the second voice of the page, not one break. Finish the process story by lifting sheet 05 off a real healed photo so the drawn sprig meets the skin, put a small healed-work plate pinned with register marks on two or three review slips, and give every photo one shared treatment (vellum-white frame plus one cool graphite grade) so they read as one shoot. Replace the cornfield break with a tight crop where skin and line work fill the frame.

Make the transfer the page's one motion verb. The hero stencil inset is laid onto the photo on load (violet dashes draw, then the vellum lifts), the same lift reveals each Styles sheet and review slip as its edge peels off the stack, and the estimator stencil redraws with the same stroke draw when the inputs change. Retire the generic fade-up stagger.
